name: Joshua Rotenberg
headline: GTM Systems & Enablement | CRM Integrations, Process Documentation & Sales Onboarding
summary: GTM systems builder who wires tools together and keeps the field self-sufficient. I integrate CRMs with outside systems through webhooks, REST APIs, Zapier, Make, and n8n, monitor and fix syncs when they drift, and document every system so teams can run it without me. I've worked in Salesforce at three companies and hands-on with Salesloft, ZoomInfo, and Apollo. At Wix I led onboarding teams of up to 30, ran weekly training, and helped build sales training for tenured account executives.

Set up and validate data feeds into Salesforce, HubSpot, and GoHighLevel, re-checking every import.
Document every system, workflow, and decision so client teams can run it independently, and train owners and staff before go-live.
Use AI in build work, calling OpenAI and Claude APIs inside production workflows and using AI to debug JSON payloads and integration errors.
